rationale: MELI gapped down ~7.5% on an earnings miss and is trading near session lows with extreme volatility (ATR $6.39 on 5m bars but the last three 1m candles show $70+ swings), making stop placement extremely difficult relative to account size. The stock is well below its 9-EMA ($1605) and VWAP ($1568), with price still in the bottom 20% of today's range and no clear stabilization — the last candle closed near the session low of $1539. With only $9,724 in equity and a $972 daily loss budget, the bid-ask spread alone (~$2.40) and the erratic price action create an unfavorable risk/reward environment where a single adverse move could breach the daily loss limit.
